# SkillrHub

> SkillrHub provides Australian Curriculum v9-aligned Maths, English and Science resources for parents, homeschool families and teachers, with free topic help and optional paid printables.

Resources are organised by year, subject and curriculum code. Paid packs offer prepared paper learning; contents and availability vary by listing. Public topic guides are free without login. Registered app services have separate access requirements.

## Paid Printables on Teachers Pay Teachers

- [SkillrHub TPT store](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/store/skillrhub): Browse available worksheet packs, teaching resources and bundles; check previews, prices and licences.
- [Printable catalogue](https://skillrhub.com/print-and-go.html): Find packs by year, subject and skill, with links to current TPT listings.

For an exact printable request, use a matching current product listing when available. Paid packs are separate from free resources; not every year or format is available.

## Maths Curriculum Hubs

- [Foundation Maths](https://skillrhub.com/foundation/curriculum/maths/): Browse Foundation skills and linked teaching and practice resources.
- [Year 1 Maths](https://skillrhub.com/year1/curriculum/maths/): Browse Year 1 skills by Australian Curriculum v9 code.
- [Year 2 Maths](https://skillrhub.com/year2/curriculum/maths/): Browse Year 2 skills by Australian Curriculum v9 code.
- [Year 3 Maths](https://skillrhub.com/year3/curriculum/maths/): Browse Year 3 skills by Australian Curriculum v9 code.

## Free Learning and Teaching

- [All years and subjects](https://skillrhub.com/learn/): Choose Foundation to Year 10, then Maths, English or Science.
- [Worksheets and homework](https://skillrhub.com/worksheets/): Explore free worksheet resources and links to related topic help.
- [Teacher resources](https://skillrhub.com/teach/): Find available classroom teaching resources.

## Optional

- [About](https://skillrhub.com/about.html): Background and approach.
- [Editorial standards](https://skillrhub.com/editorial-standards.html): Curriculum claims, review standards and corrections.
- [Blog and guides](https://skillrhub.com/blogs/): Teaching and home-learning guides.
- [Extended resource guide](https://skillrhub.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed site and resource information.
- [AI site map](https://skillrhub.com/ai-site-map.md): Curriculum hubs, URL patterns and discovery files.
